_text:
MAHANADI STEEL CORPORATION
Office of the Executive Engineer · Madhya Pradesh · IN
No. CC/27/2020/007
Dated: 31/03/2026
CERTIFICATE OF COMPLETION OF WORK
This is to certify that the work of “Rigid Pavement — Madhya Pradesh Pkg-7”
(roads highways), awarded to M/s National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. (GSTIN
19NAICC4417O1Z1, PAN NAICC4417O) , has been completed in all respects on
09/05/2020 at a gross executed value of Rs. 37.52 Crore (Rupees 37.52 Crore
Only).
The agency attended to all observations raised during execution and the work was
taken over on satisfactory completion of the final inspection.
The work was supervised on the contractor's side by Amit Iyer. This certificate
is issued for record and for submission with future tenders wherever the
contractor is required to establish past performance.
Executive Engineer
Mahanadi Steel Corporation
